clauses.scope_note: Applies to Data made available by Data Provider(s) under this agreement.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to Data made available by Data Provider(s) under this agreement; does not itself impose a sharing requirement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The Data Recipient may modify the Data if it follows the agreement’s terms.

clauses.scope_note: Permits sharing Data, with or without modifications, provided the text of this agreement is made available with the shared Data.

clauses.scope_note: Results means outcomes obtained by computational analysis of Data, including machine-learning models and insights. This clause says the agreement imposes no restrictions or obligations concerning Results; it does not itself grant permission or establish rights in Results.
clauses.condition_explanation: No conditions are stated; the clause describes the absence of restrictions or obligations imposed by this agreement, not an affirmative grant.

coverage_notes: The agreement concerns Data and computational-analysis Results, not necessarily software, and its Data Recipient grant is expressly conditioned on following the agreement.

Clause 1.2 says the agreement imposes no restriction on portions of Data usable under public-domain status or another legal exception or limitation; it does not create those independent legal bases, so no permission is inferred from it.

Commercial use, charging, paid access, network provision, source provision, sublicensing, training, and other listed activities are not expressly granted or restricted in the supplied operative clauses.
Warranty and liability terms and definitions were reviewed but do not add activity permissions or obligations within the requested ASC categories.
